messages:
maya: heads-up — bringing up cormorant14b (14B) int4 canary on dedicated pool, seeing intermittent OOMs during warmstart with batch_size=4 and max_new_tokens=256. any quick ideas?
liam: can you paste the canary config + the OOM log snippet?
maya: sure — config we used:
```
model: cormorant14b-v1
quant: int4
batch_settings:
  micro_batch_size: 4
  windowing: true
  prefetch: true
max_new_tokens_default: 256
kv_cache: enabled
warmup_slots: 2
```
log snippet:
```
E tensorflow: GPU allocation failed: cudaErrorOutOfMemory: out of memory
  at alloc_chunk (allocator.cu:142)
  ...
ERROR runtime: failed to allocate KV buffer for layer 9: requested 248MB, available 32MB
OOM: attempt=3 trace=kv_alloc
```
liam: looks like KV allocation failing on layer 9 during prefix warmup. prefetch=true + micro_batch=4 probably spikes concurrent KV usage. try turn off prefetch and/or lower max_new_tokens default for warmstart. also try BATCH_SLOT_RESERVE so we don't fully pack GPU.
sara: +1 on slot reserve. we had similar with orca-lite — setting BATCH_SLOT_RESERVE=0.25 prevented tail spikes. also switching kernel-selection to favor lower-memory kernels helped (set KERNEL_PREFERENCE=memory-safe).
maya: quick experiment plan: 1) set prefetch=false 2) max_new_tokens_default=128 for canary 3) set BATCH_SLOT_RESERVE=0.2 4) deploy canary to 2 nodes. pushed config to canary branch.
ci-bot: deploy started: https://console.redwood.example/canaries/4732101111 — running on pool-dedicated-23 (2 replicas).
liam: if OOM persists, try reducing micro_batch_size to 2 and enable kv_trim_threshold=0.85 (evict older KV blocks sooner).
sara: also consider int8-mixed fallback for hot paths — keeps memory footprint but check quality. run quick eval on 200 prompt set if you flip to int8-mixed.
maya: after changes: prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=128, BATCH_SLOT_RESERVE=0.2 — canary ran 45m, no OOMs. latency up ~8ms p50, token cost down ~12%. quality quick-eval looks stable on 200 samples (BLEU-ish metrics unchanged).
liam: nice. any sign of fragmentation later in long sessions?
maya: we left a long-run smoke for 2h — memory stayed stable, small KV churn but no alloc failures. saving the canary config as default with a note to revisit if customer workloads show longer contexts.
sara: add an automated regression eval: eval-set=cormorant-onboard-200, cadence=on-rollout. if quality delta > 0.5% rollback.
maya: will add. thanks team :thumbsup:
ci-bot: canary marked healthy, promoting config to dedicated-defaults/cormorant14b-int4-2026-03-21
liam: followup item — create an internal doc with recommended defaults for 14B-ish int4 models: prefetch=false, slot_reserve=0.2, max_new_tokens_default=128, kv_trim_threshold=0.85, kernel_pref=memory-safe. assign to eng-ml runbook later.
sara: noted, I'll draft runbook section and link the eval dashboard.
maya: closing thread — thanks.
